system.description:
Deal [2D + (Attack Power)] physical damage to the target. 

(Target: not Boss, Raid): Target's Initiative is lowered by -2. This effect is handled as Bad Status. 

(Target: Boss, Raid): Give the target [Weakness (Melee Attack): [STR mod]]. This [Weakness] is treated as Bad Status.

At the same time as attacking, countless small crane-shaped shikigami soar from the enemy's feet, blocking their movement. The crane dance, which is considered to be a good omen, is a bad omen of death for the enemy.
